title: Three Minutes
note: Yuki's day with the cathedral district slate-map. Identified the alley as the breach path. Gave the watchman a window ('Under ten minutes. Plan for five.'). Moved with him to the second junction. Counted the breach down to three minutes. Six attackers came through, hit carts + tripwire + lantern-rig, none reached the cathedral. Yuki did not see the killing because she was reading the next map. Afternoon: cathedral district fully annotated. At 14:14 she opened the pencil-case for the first time and read the be-careful slip. Cold-load resolved. Two-word yes at supper.
